semiconductor_relevance: High — Taiwan Daikin Advanced Chemicals, Inc. is a leading supplier of fluorochemicals specifically used in semiconductor applications.
summary: Taiwan Daikin Advanced Chemicals, Inc. specializes in the production of fluorochemicals, including hydrofluoric acid (HF), which are essential for various semiconductor manufacturing processes. Established as a subsidiary of Daikin Chemical Division, the company also operates a joint venture with Formosa Plastics to enhance its semiconductor material offerings.
capabilities: Production of hydrofluoric acid (HF) for semiconductor applications
Development of fluorochemical products for semiconductor manufacturing
Joint venture operations for advanced chemical production

regional_presence.Taiwan: Taiwan Daikin Advanced Chemicals has a significant presence in Taiwan, where it was established and operates its manufacturing facilities.
